summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ uses ref.startswith(self) (prefix test), ClosedNamespace.__contains__ uses node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace), and the IPython key-completion hook now returns dir(str(self.uri)). Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, SH, RDFS closed membership (including Literal and plain-string negatives), RDF closed membership, and the container property (False). Tests were not run, per instructions; changes were verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
